dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Highly irregular and jagged perimeters of 'O' and 'C' shaped rings with sharp high-contrast transitions from bright-pixel outer boundaries to dark-pixel internal centers. Prominent rings display a fractured or crenulated boundary geometry with varying pixel intensity across the ridges.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of solid light-grey pixel clusters lacking internal gradients, primarily situated in the interstitial spaces between larger annular structures and concentrated along the mid-to-lower lateral flank.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent dorsal macro-annuli form an elongated scalene triangle, while a secondary sequence of three smaller blobs along the lower-lateral axis creates a nearly linear geometric relationship.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct rectangular, high-saturation orange/red marking or tag is present on the lower neck/anterior shoulder region.
other_distinctive_markers: A complex, multi-lobed cluster of interconnected rings forming a rosette-like pattern is situated in the upper-central lateral quadrant.
